transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get our sustainment huddle started. We've got a 10,000-liter water tanker arriving at 0800 today, and I need S-4 and the maintenance chief to report any operational updates before I approve the distribution plan. transcript.text: Sir, I have an update for the clinic.
